notes: §17.4 poses the open problem: how events across the economy, the industry, politics and the company's own operations revise the forward statements. That question is unanswerable without a record of what the statements said before. A revision cannot be attributed to a cause if the prior version was overwritten — all a reader can then see is that the number is different. So every projection computed is now retained as a dated snapshot, and the object of study is the series of pro formas rather than the latest one.
